must_identify.item: The api Service has no endpoints
must_identify.evidence: This label/selector mismatch means the Service has zero matching endpoints (Endpoints api → subsets: null).

must_identify.item: Its selector (app=api-v2) does not match the pod labels (app=api)
must_identify.evidence: The api Service in namespace shop has selector app: api-v2, but the api Deployment's pods carry label app: api (pods api-f64486c4c-mhlpd, api-f64486c4c-xwrxt).

notes: The RCA's claim that the last-applied-configuration annotation still records app=api should be checked against the actual service output, as should the odd claim that redis connectivity was 'confirmed in the app code'. Neither affects the correct diagnosis or fix; there is also a minor typo ('app-v2' instead of 'app: api-v2').
